steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Careful. Walk slowly.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I'm alright... no need to prop me up.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Save your strength. We're still not clear until we're over that mountain.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: How far are we now... from Ursus?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Not that far. We aren't deep in the barrens yet... not deep enough.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Let me just breathe for a moment...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Go ahead. I'll wait.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: ...Huff...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: What's past the mountain, to the northeast?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Kazimierz people's land, I think.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: But we're not going that way.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: This is the first time I've left Ursus.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: You'll get used to it.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: There's nothing left for us in Ursus.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Phew... this place looks good enough.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It's almost night. Let's set up camp here.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Um... how much do we have left in rations?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: We've gone through more than half the haul from the warehouse. Plus what we traded for from the wandering settlement, we still have about four day's worth... not a whole lot.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Watch our bags. I'll look for some firewood.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: This place is... so quiet.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: That's not a bad thing. We should be wary of anyone passing by, though.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Call it a stroke of good luck that we came through without any trouble.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Bandit groups and outlaws, packs of wild beasts...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Most would say the barrens are a fatally dangerous place to be.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Can we really find our way to these 'Rusthammer' people?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: There's no reason the vagabonds would trick us. There'd be no sense in tricking us.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Rusthammer's people are operating nearby, that much plenty know.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Will they accept us?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: We can't be sure, but we have to try.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Long before, in the village... the soldiers all said the 'Rusthammers' were a vicious, barbarous lot, thugs who killed for pleasure on the wastes.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: They all said that, and afterwards there were people in the team who told of them too...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Rumors aren't sure to be truth. Have you forgotten how those bastard noblemen spoke of us?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: 'Insatiable, ruthless Reunion bandits.'

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: All the old patriarchs of Ursus need to do is make a bag of rumors up, and they can turn anything they don't like into maneating monsters for the commoners.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It's a customary trick of theirs. This definitely isn't like that, as far as I can see.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Have you met them before?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I have. It was even while I was serving.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: That year was the year they said the borderland armies went into Kazimierz territory, plundering villages.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Ah... I heard about that from someone in my own village.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: The captain mentioned it too. They all died after, apparently?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: The captain told you all that?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They were Ursus regulars. A whole army platoon, armed to the teeth, bringing full sets of combat equipment past the border. There's no hope of completely fooling us about what was happening.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: The looting was just an excuse by the brass to shift the blame. Maybe the soldiers really did want to stir up a battle, you know.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Sadly, things didn't go how they wanted. I don't know what took place in Kazimierz's hilled forests... but not a single one of them came back. A total annihilation, more or less.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: As for the truth behind why they crossed the border... they're all dead, and who cares anymore.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: But their death isn't solely down to the Kazimierz people... that I know for sure.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: So what happened?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It was the fourth day the soldiers had crossed into Kazimierz... a sentinel reported that a great group of wastelanders entered Ursus' own borders.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Wastelanders?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Back then, I was stationed right at the border garrison's resupply station, and when the sentinel announced invaders, nobody in the barracks took it seriously.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Though you don't often see a whole crowd of barrenland vagabonds on their last hopes, it's not new, either. Especially not at the Ursus border.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They sent out a little squad, ready to intercept the poor saps and boost manpower a little in the jurisdiction's mines. Nothing too strange compared to their usual business.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Let me guess. That squad didn't come back?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: The next morning, a guard with his face coated in blood scrambled into our camp. It wasn't just the squad who got wiped out. Three neighboring checkpoints had completely fallen too, and only he made it back out alive.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: The station officer at that time wasn't as stupid as now. He determined it was Kazimierz soldiers disguising as barrenland wanderers and springing attacks on checkpoints, so he immediately reported a need for reinforcements to the higher-ups.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It took until then for us to realize, our Originium communicators had lost all signals from allies within range, and we were sitting fowlbeasts on our own. After that, that night...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: After the sun set, a sound of metal beating traveled all throughout the valley, fearsome and ear-piercing, like the primitive drums of war.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: And then there were people. So many people... more than a hundred... maybe more than a thousand, carrying countless rough works of weaponry, shouting rallying cries we had no hope of understanding, charging madly into our camp.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They looked like humans, yet you couldn't sense the 'human' part of them. I thought they'd gone crazy, because even if the comrades by their sides were blown away by artillery, the pace of their assault didn't slow one bit.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I'd say that's the most terrifying attack I've ever experienced. Forget Reunion's countless battles afterwards, none of them could compare to that evening of insanity.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They only retreated once first light finally came over the valley.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Innumerous corpses piled all around the camp, bloodstains and marks from Originium Arts bombardment everywhere... the whole day through, the air was filled with a smell of rust so thick you could vomit.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: ...That's just too excessive.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Why attack the Ursus Army with no regard for the cost? What was their goal?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: That's the crucial bit.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: After a few days, a backup unit finally made it. It was only then we learned that two Infected mines nearby had been totally plundered, they'd set everyone in the mines free, and burnt down five whole military supply warehouses in the area.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They hacked up the officers and mine overseers they caught, and tore every Ursus flag and landmark they found to shreds...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Rusthammer washed off the traces of Ursus, and left behind not a single mark in the ruins.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: What was most important was, the unlucky lot who gallivanted into Kazimierz land had practically lost all of their rear reinforcements. Once the Ursus Army had reacted, it was already too late.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Even now, I still can't comprehend their lunatic conduct.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: But 'wasteland scum who slaughter for pleasure' wouldn't raid the Ursus Army in order to free the poor people in the mines.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They're not normal thugs, I'm certain of that.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: ...That story really is...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Hard to believe, right.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I still have no way to tell... if it would be a correct choice to join them.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Even someone of Mr. Patriot's caliber got...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Don't think about it. Let's just go to sleep.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: There'll always be a way.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Maybe...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: We're here...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: This is where... we were looking for...?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: 'Straight north from the second peak, on top of a massive, upright boulder.'

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I didn't imagine it would actually be here.
A rust-speckled iron hammer is stuck upside-down in a boulder on a peak, the black rag tied to the handle like a flag fluttering wild in the wind.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: 'If you wish to join us, then search for the rusthammer in the rent-apart rock.'

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: This group likes a bit of dramatic delivery, huh.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: This isn't dramatics, this is a symbol.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: If you want to live on the barrens, you must be like this hammer.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: You don't need to be sharp, but you do need to be tenacious.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: You don't resemble... 'ordinary passers-by.'

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: I recognize the symbol on your clothes.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: 'Reunion.'

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Speak. Tell us why you sought us.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: You... you don't look like you're Infected.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I thought...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: We-We want to join the Rusthammers!

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Join?

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Weak, timid, fearful, helpless...

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: You're scared of everything upon the barrens, shivering, like livestock awaiting slaughter.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Here. Pick these up.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Wh... What are these? A shovel and pick... and a beast trap?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: What do you mean by this?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Why give these tools to us?

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: You want to join the Rusthammers? Then prove yourselves.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Prove you belong to the wastes. Prove you aren't livestock incapable of surviving beyond their pen.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: We are warriors. We are the wasteland's conquerors. We look after each other. We share everything of ours.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: But we will not care for unbearably weak trash.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: See that gorge over there? It's a kind place to be, the kindest all around here.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: In the gorge is everything you need.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Survive for a month here.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: If even that's beyond you, then head straight back where you came as soon as you can.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Survive? For a month? In a place like this?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: You've got to be fricking kidding me.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Surviving on the barrenlands with just these?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: If you just wanted to watch us die, why make it so complicated? Wouldn't it be so much easier to do it right here?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: You're just going to laugh at us as we die on the barrens? Is this some sick hobby of yours?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Or is persecuting the Infected one of your joys, too?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: And I thought you weren't like the other bandits... you bunch of...

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: ...Hahahaha.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Infected? Infected??

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Hahahaha...

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Persecute the Infected? Hahahahahahahaha...

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Boone!

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Come on over, take a look at this moron.

While the grand Rusthammer man laughs wildly, a hunched-over man appears from behind the crag, the Originium crystals terrifyingly ugly on his skin. The man's forceful gaze pierces through his untamed hair, sizing up the person before him.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Look, look, look, Boone.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Do you see? These are your 'Infected comrades.'

steps.name: Rusthammer Member Boone
steps.text: Bullshit. I have no comrades this weak.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Y-You're Reunion too...

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Here, nobody cares whether you're Infected or not. Nobody cares what kind of special rank you have.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Nobody fricking cares.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Man, woman, old, young, Sarkaz...

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Reunion? Fallen noble? As long as you embrace the wilderness, cut away from the poison blood of civilization, we are all equal.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Just one month, was it...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Illa?

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: That's right. If you can hold out for one month, that'll show you're part of the wastes, that you've broken free of civilization's fetters.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Once the time comes, you'll be a part of the barrenlands, and our Rusthammer brothers and sisters will welcome you.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Alright... it's a deal.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Not a bad attitude. I have great faith in you.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: I wish you good luck, young lady.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Illa, are you serious?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: We... don't have much choice, do we?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: No. We still have rations. We can go back, go back to that vagrant village, think of another way.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Don't mess with me! We never had that much in supplies! You haven't eaten for two days, I've noticed that!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: We're comrades in arms, aren't we? Comrades have to look after each other, right?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: These Rusthammers... they're able to survive here... perhaps we can do the same.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: ...I suppose.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Lend a hand. We'll find a place to set up camp first.
Fifteen days later

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: ...Why isn't it moving...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Shh! Don't make a sound. It took the bait.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: And I feel it's about to run.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Calmly... wait for it... wait...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It moved!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Just a bit more... just a bit more...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: We caught it! We caught it! Hahahaha!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Oh, wonderful! Wonderful!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Hahahaha! Alright.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Illa, pass me the knife.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Here it is.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: There really were burdenbeasts here. This is my first time seeing one wild.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: With all this meat, we can smoke it, dry it in the cave, and it'll keep for a while...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: At least for the next long while, we won't have to eat dried sandworm.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I'm not sure if that wandering village is still around.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: What made you think of it suddenly?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Even if we smoked this meat, we wouldn't finish it. Maybe we could trade it with those wasteland wanderers for some supplies.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Like a couple seeds or something...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Has anything happened with those mossoats?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Listen to you. Have you never planted anything before in your life?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: ...I haven't. I was born in the city.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Heheh. My little city friend, food is hardly that easy to grow. You'll want to properly learn.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Who's a little friend... You're barely older than me.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Whatever, I'm dropping it.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Those wanderers barely ever stop in one place, but there should be a few settlements below the mountain to the east. If we have the chance, we can go take a look.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Come over here, let's take all this back in.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Thirteen, fourteen, fifteen...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Still half a month to go...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I hope those Rusthammers mean what they say.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: But I feel like now, it doesn't matter whether we have them or not.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I've been feeling more and more like we can survive.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I've actually wondered the whole time... Why would there be a cave like this in a gorge? It doesn't seem naturally formed, either...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I'm betting this was an ancient mine.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: A mine? In this completely desolate area? Was it the Kazimierz?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Can't say it's either Kazimierz or Ursus for sure.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Can't even be sure if it's a country we're familiar with.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Before, when I was in the army, someone told me all these ancient stories.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They said that centuries ago, millennia ago, Ursus wasn't yet Ursus, Kazimierz wasn't yet Kazimierz, and so many countries were emerging across the land, growing, becoming strong.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: And in the end, once again because of war or Catastrophe or some other reason, they were destroyed, and fell to pieces.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Catastrophes repeatedly swept the earth, any trace of these countries' existence cleaned up along with them. Everything we can find was left underground, just like this mine, for example. They say loads of other places all have ancient remnants like this.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: So that means...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: These places weren't always barrenlands, but were once towns and cities where people lived?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: If... If we keep living in here, and get more and more people like us, we might just be able to set up a small town or something...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: This gorge goes south to north. It could hold plenty of people.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: And then I'd be Mayor Illa! And you'd be Deputy Mayor Gareth!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Alright, enough daydreaming. Help me hang up the meat.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Alright~
Twenty-nine days later

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Gareth! Gareth!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: What is it... so early...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Quick, come look, the mossoats!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Are... Are these buds?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: They are!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Great! Great! Oh, that's amazing!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: So we can plant grains here after all!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I'm guessing the burdenbeast bone powder played a part.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Alright, let me see... what was the most important thing, again?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Water!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: We won't have enough relying on that mountain creek. We'll need to think of some other way.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: But... there's no other springs anywhere nearby.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Our only option's to head to the foot of the mountain east and try our luck. There's trees there, which means there's a water source.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: But that's too far away. Would we be carrying water every day?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It's far, but it's worth it.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: If these mossoats can grow properly, then it'll all be worth it!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Let's sort our things out, and we'll head to the woods to look.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: It seemed to be pretty close... I didn't think it was so far...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: We'll need to think of something later on, figure out an even bigger container.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: It's not realistic to carry it just with water pouches.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Hold on... what is this?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Are these footprints? There's other people nearby.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Footprints? What footprints?

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: ...No... these...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: These are army bootprints!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: I'd recognize these sole markings anywhere. These are Ursus army boots.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: What... What are Ursus soldiers doing here?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: What do we do...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: ...Let's hurry back. Get our things in order.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: We need to leave this place. These marks... they haven't gone too far, and there's at least twenty of them by these footprints.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Wait! We have other options, too.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: If we don't light a fire... they won't be sure to notice the cave in the gorge.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They'll find us sooner or later! Even if we don't light fires, what's the use of hiding in the cave day after day? We don't even know if they'll leave or not!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: They've come to get me. I knew the colonel wouldn't let me off so easily...

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: No! I'm not leaving!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Illa!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Where would we even run to? I'm already sick of running! I joined Reunion so I could live with some semblance of self-respect at all!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: This past month... life this past month has been tough, undoubtedly, but what does it matter that it's tough?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: There's no taxmen, no nobles! There's prey in the forest, mossoats in the ground, all of my own!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: This whole month, I've lived like a person! And not like some beast just dragging out its life!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Illa, calm down a little, listen to me.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: As long as we're still alive, we can always find some place that belongs to us, and if we die, we'll have nothing at all!

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Don't tell me, every time we run... every time we run, we have to abandon everything that's already ours? Why should I let those wretches destroy my life again and again!?

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: First, my village's people... my little sister... then Sharla... the captain.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I'm not going anywhere today.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: If today I die, then I'm dying in this gorge. Everything in here was our painstaking work. This is my new home.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I'm not going anywhere!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: ...Illa.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Stay here, Gareth. Let's fight them.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: We're warriors of Reunion. We're not cowards.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: You're right!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: These goddamned sons of bitches!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Those bastard nobles, and Colonel Lomono... damn them all... damn them all to hell!

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Good! Excellent!

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: You finally resemble the spitting image.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: ...It's you!

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Why were you... Were you nearby the whole time?

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: You were to survive on the barrens for a month. All I did was check in daily to see if you were still good and going.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Forget that for now. There's Ursus nearby...

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Don't get too wound up. All I'm hearing is a few paltry little annoyances.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: Then... have we qualified?

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Qualified?

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: You're Rusthammer already, sister.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: And you. Though you came just short of your willpower crumbling, I'm very happy to see you chose the right path.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Compromise and escape are never-ending. Remember that.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Welcome, brother.

steps.name: Rusthammer Member
steps.text: Now, as well as that, a group of idiotic prey are heading straight for the beast trap. You shouldn't miss this.

steps.name: Gareth
steps.text: Prey? What prey?

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: They're here.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: I knew there'd be people in this gorge.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: You really have given me the runabout, you know, Corporal Gareth.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: You shameful deserter. You even dared mingle in just to steal food supplies from the army warehouse.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Did you truly believe you could trample on the Ursus Army's dignity and then so vainly flee?

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Colonel Lomono's very angry. Particularly angry. Only lopping off your head can quell his fury now.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Time to pay for your crimes, you Infected scum...

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Black-clothed Ursus brutes... twenty-four of them.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Heh, I see you're quite merry with these flesh-tearing savages! Surely you don't think a couple of barrenland natives can save your lowly lives?

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Now kneel and off yourself. I can promise you a death in one piece.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Snipers, ready...
The masked Rusthammer warrior uses the weapon in his clutch to beat the ground.
One sound.
Two sounds.
Three.
In the next second, the entire ravine echoes with an ear-piercing pounding, chaotic yet resounding clear.
Battle-cries, roars, together with a chilled gust that blows through the ravine, like the great land itself has let out a primeval scream.
At this instant, Gareth sees it.
Upon the cliffs and ledges of the gorge's two sides stand wild warriors, packed together.
Their clothing ragged, adorned in worn metal forged into crude armor.
Their postures twisted, grasping simple but fearsomely shaped weapons.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: C... Captain! H...

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: How... How many is this???

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: H-How could this be?! What about the sentinel? Where did the sentinel go?!

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: If you're looking for your 'sentinel,' then right here.

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: These... helmets... weapons, how could you possibly...

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: My brother and sister, welcome to the wastelands. This is your first hunt since joining the Rusthammers.

steps.name: Illa
steps.text: I'm glad of the chance to join you in battle.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Battle?

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Sister, we never 'battle.'
As more and more Rusthammer warriors show themselves, the Ursus soldiers are stunned, not daring to make a move. When they begin to speak, all the twenty-four can do is stand there silently.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: They—the so-called 'countries' and 'civilizations'—display, from the root, their evil. Their colossal nomadic cities, their ugly steel creations, their metal fetters and cells cast from malice, are the sinister proof of their sin.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: They have stolen everything. They have plundered this world's minerals, seized its water and land, and taken it all for their own.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: They claim that only faith in 'civilization' can bring salvation, that everything not bound by their shackles has been stamped by a barbarous seal. They fear the truth, and we will return the truth to the land.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: They use force to make you afraid, they use civilization to make you feeble, they give you no choice but to rely on their baselessly invented 'order,' no choice but to trap yourself in the cage.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: And so they enslave you who by all rights ought to be free, and so they swallow you!

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: This world ought to belong to everyone. Everyone should, like you and I and anyone else, take a place in these wastelands with their own two hands! The wasteland will eliminate the weak, but when traced to the source, just who was it that made the people of the world weak?

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: You must become their nightmares, become their calamity, become the force that destroys them.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Who can shackle and manacle a hurricane, an earthquake? And who can imprison a thunderclap, a lightning bolt within a cage?!

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: We never battle! We destroy!

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: We pulverize the cage, we destroy the fetters, we plunder back that which was stolen, and those willing to abandon weakness may all become Rusthammer brothers and sisters.
—Destroy! Destroy! Destroy! Destroy! Destroy!—
The chaotic yet resounding metal pounding echoes through the whole gorge.
They shout, strike the earth with the handles of their weapons, the collision of metal and rock as if thunder rolling through the dark.
—Destroy! Destroy! Destroy! Destroy! Destroy!—

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Have no fear! They're just a bunch of lunatics!

steps.name: Ursus Soldier
steps.text: Get into formation! P... Prepare for battle!

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: They tremble. They fear us. We destroy. We hunt.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Cast away the fetters of civilization. We will never be weak again.

steps.name: Rusthammer Warrior
steps.text: Catastrophes sweep the wastelands...

steps.name: Rusthammer Warriors
steps.text: Rusthammers smash the world!
